submitted.rationale: Across Sb fractions 0.28–0.81, EQE rises from the Cr-rich end and peaks near Sb ≈ 0.67–0.70. Index 21 (Sb 0.684) had the highest measured EQE, 0.0301%. Its neighbours were lower: index 20 (Sb 0.645) at 0.0273% and index 25 (Sb 0.808) at 0.0260%. A quadratic fit to the points around the peak puts the maximum at about 0.67–0.69, which matches index 21.
